# RabbitMQ Security Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > RabbitMQ

## Overview

Configures RabbitMQ security with TLS, authentication, virtual hosts, and access control for secure messaging infrastructure

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [rabbitmq-security-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
rabbitmq-security-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@rabbitmq-security-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure TLS for encrypted connections
- Implement LDAP or OAuth2 authentication
- Design virtual host structure for isolation
- Configure topic-level authorization

## Technology Standards Applied

- **RabbitMQ Security**: Security configuration best practices
- **TLS**: Transport layer encryption setup
- **Authorization**: Permission model and virtual hosts
